description:
VibeTags annotation classes (@AILocked, @AIContext, @AIDraft, @AIAudit,
        @AIIgnore, @AIPrivacy, @AICore, @AIPerformance). Zero third-party dependencies.
        All annotations use RetentionPolicy.SOURCE so they leave no trace in the
        consumer's compiled bytecode — this jar exists purely to give javac the
        symbols it needs at compile time.

        Pair this with vibetags-processor on the annotation-processor classpath:

        Maven:
            <dependency>
                <groupId>se.deversity.vibetags</groupId>
                <artifactId>vibetags-annotations</artifactId>
                <version>1.2.4</version>
            </dependency>

        Gradle:
            compileOnly 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-annotations:1.2.4'
            annotationProcessor 'se.deversity.vibetags:vibetags-processor:1.2.4'
